_meta.purpose: Ranked trustworthiness of knowledge sources. Referenced by every config entry's provenance.evidence_tier.

tiers.name: Consensus statements & position stands
tiers.best_for: Default safe recommendations and safety rails
tiers.caution: Can lag the newest research; sometimes conservative

tiers.name: Systematic reviews & meta-analyses
tiers.caution: Heterogeneity; mostly young trained males; some exploratory

tiers.name: Major textbooks
tiers.caution: Can lag newest evidence; some theory ahead of data

tiers.name: Leading researchers / primary literature
tiers.caution: Individual studies aren't consensus; follow findings, not personalities

tiers.name: Evidence-based practitioners / orgs
tiers.best_for: Practical frameworks and heuristics (e.g. volume landmarks, SFR)
tiers.caution: Heuristics/models, not validated measurements — flag as such
